items.t: Prophylaxis of angina pectoris. Not for relief of an acute angina attack (use sublingual GTN).

src.q: Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets is indicated for the prophylaxis of angina pectoris.
Imdur is not indicated for relief of acute angina attacks

restrictions.note: No prescribing restriction or brand-specific prescribing statement found in the SmPCs used; no MHRA or SPS brand-prescribing advice found.

items.t: Immediate-release: one tablet two or three times a day, taken asymmetrically to allow a nitrate-low period. Nitrate-naive: start 20 mg twice daily. Usual maintenance 20-120 mg daily; use the lowest effective dose.

src.q: One tablet to be taken asymmetrically (to allow a nitrate low period) two or three times a day.
it is recommended that the initial dose be one tablet of Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets 20 mg twice a day.
The maintenance dose in individual patients is usually between 20- 120 mg daily.

items.t: MR tablets: 60 mg once daily in the morning; may increase to 120 mg (two tablets) once daily in the morning. To reduce headache, may start with 30 mg (half a tablet) for the first 2-4 days.

src.q: Imdur 60mg (one tablet) once daily given in the morning. The dose may be increased to 120mg (two tablets) daily, both to be taken once daily in the morning.
The dose can be titrated to minimise the possibility of headache, by initiating treatment with 30mg (half a tablet) for the first 2-4 days.

items.t: MR capsules: one or two capsules daily in the morning; use the lowest effective dose. If effect wanes on prolonged-release treatment, intermittent therapy may be more suitable.

src.q: One capsule to be taken daily, or two capsules daily, in the morning.
Attenuation of effect has occurred in some patients being treated with prolonged release preparations. In such patients intermittent therapy may be more appropriate

items.t: Do not stop suddenly; taper dose and frequency gradually.

src.q: Treatment with Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets, as with any other nitrates, should not be stopped suddenly. Both the dosage and frequency should be tapered gradually
Treatment with Elantan LA, as with any other nitrate, should not be stopped suddenly.

items.t: Elderly: no routine adjustment, but special care if prone to hypotension or with marked hepatic or renal insufficiency.

src.q: No evidence of a need for routine dosage adjustment in older people has been found, but special care may be needed in those with increased susceptibility to hypotension or marked hepatic or renal insufficiency.

items.t: Safety and efficacy in children not established (all three SmPCs).

src.q: The safety and efficacy of Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets 20 mg has yet to be established in children.
The safety and efficacy of Imdur in children has not yet been established.
The safety and efficacy of Elantan LA has yet to be established in children.

items.t: With PDE5 inhibitors (e.g. sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil) - all formulations.

src.q: their co-administration with nitrates or nitric oxide donors is therefore contraindicated
Patients treated with Imdur must not be given Phosphodiesterase Type 5 Inhibitors (e.g. sildenafil).

items.t: Hypersensitivity to isosorbide mononitrate (immediate-release tablets and MR capsules: also other nitrates; immediate-release tablets: also isosorbide dinitrate).

src.q: This product should not be given to patients with a known hypersensitivity to isosorbide dinitrate or mononitrate, to other nitrates or to any of the excipients.
Hypersensitivity to the active substance, other nitrates or to any of the excipients listed in section 6.1.

items.t: Immediate-release tablets and MR capsules: acute MI with low filling pressures; acute circulatory failure (shock, vascular collapse); very low blood pressure; HOCM; constrictive pericarditis; cardiac tamponade; low filling pressures; aortic/mitral stenosis; raised intracranial pressure (e.g. head trauma, cerebral haemorrhage); severe anaemia; closed-angle glaucoma; severe hypotension; hypovolaemia; toxic pulmonary oedema (immediate-release); riociguat.

src.q: 4.3 Contraindications Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets 20 mg should not be used in cases of acute myocardial infarction with low filling pressures, acute circulatory failure (shock, vascular collapse), or very low blood pressure
aortic/mitral valve stenosis and diseases associated with a raised intra-cranial pressure e.g. following a head trauma and including cerebral haemorrhage.
Elantan LA should not be used in patients with severe anaemia, closed angle glaucoma, severe hypotension or severe hypovolaemia.
should not be used in patients with marked anaemia, sever hypotension, closed angle glaucoma, toxic pulmonary oedema or hypovolaemia.

items.t: MR tablets: constrictive cardiomyopathy and pericarditis, aortic stenosis, cardiac tamponade, mitral stenosis, severe anaemia.

src.q: Constrictive cardiomyopathy and pericarditis, aortic stenosis, cardiac tamponade, mitral stenosis and severe anaemia.

items.t: Relative contraindications (immediate-release tablets and MR tablets): severe cerebrovascular insufficiency or hypotension.

src.q: Severe cerebrovascular insufficiency or hypotension are relative contraindications to the use of Imdur.

items.t: Use with caution after recent myocardial infarction, and in hypothyroidism, hypothermia, malnutrition, severe liver or renal disease (immediate-release tablets and MR capsules). MR capsules: avoid lowering systolic BP below 90 mmHg.

src.q: should be used with caution in patients who have a recent history of myocardial infarction, or who are suffering from closed-angle glaucoma, hypothyroidism, hypothermia, malnutrition and sever liver or renal disease.
Reducing systolic blood-pressure below 90 mmHg must be avoided.

items.t: Postural hypotension and syncope can occur; circulatory collapse may follow the first dose with labile circulation (immediate-release: also in patients already on ACE inhibitors). Nitrate hypotension may come with paradoxical bradycardia and worse angina.

src.q: Symptoms of circulatory collapse may arise after first dose in patients with labile circulation and in patients already taking ACE inhibitors.
Hypotension induced by nitrates may be accompanied by paradoxical bradycardia and increased angina.

items.t: Tolerance and cross-tolerance to other nitrates can develop if not taken as directed (immediate-release: keep the asymmetric nitrate-low period). Avoid continuously high doses (MR capsules).

src.q: If the tablets are not taken as indicated (see section 4.2) tolerance to the medication and cross-tolerance to other nitrates may occur.
Continuously high dosages should be avoided.

items.t: MR capsules: caution in hypoxaemia and ventilation/perfusion imbalance (lung disease, ischaemic heart failure). Fast gastrointestinal transit may reduce release from MR formulations.

src.q: Caution should be exercised in patients with hypoxaemia and ventilation/perfusion imbalance due to lung disease or ischaemic heart failure.
In patients with decreased gastrointestinal transit time, and using prolonged-release formulation of isosorbide mononitrate, a decrease in release of the active ingredient may occur.

items.t: MR capsules: do not interrupt nitrate therapy in order to take a PDE5 inhibitor (risk of angina attack).

src.q: Elantan therapy should not be interrupted to take phosphodiesterase inhibitor-containing products (e.g. sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil), because the risk of inducing an attack of angina pectoris could increase by doing so

items.t: Immediate-release tablets and MR capsules contain lactose and sucrose: patients with rare hereditary galactose or fructose intolerance, total lactase deficiency, glucose-galactose malabsorption or sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency should not take them.

src.q: patients with rare hereditary problems of galactose or fructose intolerance, total lactase deficiency, sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine.
Patients with rare hereditary problems of galactose intolerance, total lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine.
Due to the presence of sucrose, patients with rare hereditary problems of fructose intolerance, glucose-galactose malabsorption or sucrase-isomaltase insufficiency should not take this medicine.

items.t: PDE5 inhibitors (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil): potentiate hypotension; possible syncope, MI or life-threatening cardiovascular complications. Must not be used together.

src.q: Patients who are on Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets therapy therefore must not use phosphodiesterase type-5 inhibitors.
Imdur and Phosphodiesterase Type 5 Inhibitors (e.g. sildenafil) must not be given concomitantly.

items.t: Blood-pressure-lowering medicines (beta-blockers, calcium-channel blockers, vasodilators, ARBs, ACE inhibitors), neuroleptics, tricyclic antidepressants and alcohol may increase the hypotensive effect. MR capsules: if the BP fall with ACE inhibitors or arterial vasodilators is excessive, consider reducing one or both doses.

src.q: Concurrent administration of drugs with blood pressure lowering properties, e.g, beta-blockers, calcium channel blockers, vasodilators, alprostadil, aldesleukin, angiotensin II receptor antagonist, ACE inhibitors etc. may potentiate the hypotensive effect

The concurrent intake of ISMN with ACE-inhibitors or arterial vasodilators could be a desirable interaction unless the antihypertensive effects are excessive in which case consider reducing the dose of one or both drugs.

items.t: Riociguat: contraindicated (immediate-release tablets and MR capsules). Dihydroergotamine: levels and hypertensive effect may rise.

src.q: The use of isosorbide mononitrate with riociguat, a stimulator of soluble guanylate cyclase, is contra-indicated
may increase the blood level of dihydroergotamine and its hypertensive effect.

src.q: Dosage should be reduced in patients with renal or hepatic impairment.

items.t: MR capsules: unknown whether nitrates pass into milk; use caution. No SPS breastfeeding page for nitrates was found.

src.q: It is not known whether nitrates are excreted in human milk and therefore caution should be exercised when administered to nursing women.

items.t: Fertility: no human data (MR capsules).

src.q: There is no data available on the effect of isosorbide mononitrate on fertility in humans.

items.t: Very common: throbbing headache (usually fades after 1-3 weeks). Common: hypotension or light-headedness on standing (especially at start or after a dose increase), dizziness, tachycardia, nausea (MR tablets), somnolence and asthenia (MR capsules).

src.q: A very common (>10% of patients) adverse reaction to Isosorbide Mononitrate Tablets is throbbing headache.
At the start of therapy or when the dosage is increased, hypotension and/or light headedness in the upright position are commonly observed
Nervous system disorders Common Headache, dizziness
Cardiac and vascular disorders Common Hypotension, tachycardia Gastrointestinal disorders Common Nausea
very common: headache, common: dizziness (including dizziness postural), somnolence.

items.t: Uncommon: collapse (sometimes with bradyarrhythmia and syncope); severe hypotension that may worsen angina.

src.q: Uncommonly collapse may occur (sometimes accompanied by bradyarrhythmia and syncope). Uncommonly severe hypotension may lead to enhanced angina symptoms.

items.t: Rare/single cases: exfoliative dermatitis; angioedema (MR capsules, frequency not known). Nitrate-induced pituitary apoplexy reported in undiagnosed pituitary tumours.

items.t: MR tablets: do not chew or crush; swallow whole with half a glass of water, in the morning. The empty tablet matrix may be seen in the stool.

src.q: Imdur Tablets must not be chewed or crushed. They should be swallowed whole with half a glass of water.

src.q: In the event of an acute angina attack, sublingual treatment such as a GTN spray or tablet should be used instead of isosorbide mononitrate tablets.
